next.reason: 1985: "{ SUM { identifier-1 } … [ UPON { data-name-1 } … ] } … [ RESET ON { data-name-2 | FINAL } ]"; 2023: "SUM OF { data-name-1 | identifier-1 | arithmetic-expression-1 } … [ UPON … ] … [ RESET ON … ] [ rounded-phrase ]". Same SUM clause format, but 2023 adds arithmetic-expression-1 addends, an optional OF and an optional rounded-phrase, so more programs are accepted.
